claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Methimazole at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen; its known pharmacology (TPO inhibition, Prx I induction, FMO3 inhibition) does not produce direct cytotoxicity at this concentration, and agranulocytosis is a rare idiosyncratic immune-mediated effect not captured in cell lines.
